prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A strict asset contact sheet with exactly three columns and exactly two rows on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly six TOTAL separate single objects, one centered in each equal invisible cell with generous empty charcoal margin. Top row left to right: ONE plain matte coral-red four-hole button; ONE plain matte sky-blue four-hole button; ONE plain matte marigold-yellow four-hole button. Bottom row left to right: ONE plain matte plum-purple four-hole button; ONE plain matte mint-green four-hole button; ONE golden stitched-fabric star sequin with a tiny center hole. Each button is one solid color and one single disk. Cozy tactile fabric detail, rounded edges, contained soft shadow. Absolutely no stacked buttons, no backing disks, no extra colored rings, no piles, no duplicates, no borders, labels, text, letters, hands, or loose thread.
